decisions.reason: Identifies PID 42432 (dsh web host node.exe) as the koffi.node loader and explains the loaded PE image stays in use until that process exits, so npm's copyfile gets EBUSY.
Explains refreshing only reloads the SPA while the host keeps the module mapped; gives the ordered procedure: stop/verify host exit, install, verify version, restart.
Explains an unversioned install follows latest=0.1.1-rc.2 (alpha holds alpha.5), silently replacing the newer alpha.4 rather than preserving or upgrading it.
Gives npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.2-alpha.5 plus the TUI install after stopping the host, verifies dsh --version is alpha.5, restarts; @alpha mentioned only as a mutable alternative.
Tells README authors to pin exact tested versions for core and plugin (including combined commands), avoid silently following latest over an installed prerelease, and add stop/verify guidance.
